59cd99e26320:
✤ 12 January: the feast of the icon of the Mother of God “the Nursing Mother” (Galaktotrophousa)

• “How shall I approach Your swaddling clothes, You who are wrapped in rays"? says the Mother of God in a prayer-hymn on the Nativity of the Lord, written by Saint Ephrem the Syrian.

• Over time, this icon has been made on wood or on glass, in various versions. One of the oldest such depictions of the Mother of God is on the Holy Mountain of Athos (Hilandar Monastery). Other depictions of this theme, as miniatures, are found in manuscripts. Many delightful depictions are found in the icons on glass of the Transylvanian icon painters. One of them was made in a workshop in Șcheii Brașovului in the second half of the 19th century, and it is the model after which we made this icon in our workshop.

• The icon “the Nursing Mother” (Galaktotrophousa) is celebrated on 12 January and 2 July.

• The icon is not available; contact me if you would like an icon on this theme.

• 29 June: «The Holy Apostles Peter and Paul»

• Patriarch Daniel: “The Holy Apostles Peter and Paul – teachers of faith, repentance and the Church's mission in the world; the Holy Apostles Peter and Paul are two different men, called by Jesus Christ to proclaim the same Gospel of merciful love and of the salvation of the world.”

• We welcome the great feast with the most recent icon of Saints Peter and Paul (a study after an icon from the wooden church of Dângăul Mare, Cluj County, 18th century).

• Happy name day to all who celebrate!

66a2aadd849e:
❀ Saint Eugenia the Martyr – Icon on glass

• Saint Eugenia lived in the 3rd century, in Rome and Alexandria. She is known for the wisdom, courage and purity of soul of her life. The daughter of a Roman official, she gave up wealth and social position and followed Christ in secret, disguised as a monk, until her faith was discovered and she suffered martyrdom for the name of the Lord.

• The Orthodox Church celebrates her on 24 December.
687e62d9327e: Saint Eugenia the Martyr, an early Christian Roman martyr – pen-and-ink drawing on the “back” of the glass (22x26 cm)
ee176216341e:
✤ 9 June 2025 – The Holy Trinity ✤

• Fr. Teofil Părăian: "We believe that God is One in being and threefold in person. It is a mystery of our faith, perhaps the greatest mystery, something we cannot understand but can receive through faith. This is the divine revelation."

• On the Monday after Pentecost Sunday (which is dedicated to glorifying the Holy Trinity), we are showing you the icon painted on glass in our workshop: «The Holy Trinity and the Coronation of the Mother of God» (model: workshop in Șcheii Brașovului, 19th century)

• The scene shows the Holy Trinity (the spiritual unity of the three divine persons): Jesus Christ carrying the Cross of the crucifixion, God the Father with the orb and sceptre (the insignia of the Almighty), and the Holy Spirit (as a white dove framed by the sun) sending down His blessing. The first two hold a crown above the head of the Virgin Mary (kneeling, dressed in a red maphorion, with her hands crossed on her chest). The figures are ”held up” by clouds.

• This icon was made to order, so it is not available. If you would like a similar icon, contact me.

6d8f81b3bcde:
• 21 May – «The Ascension of the Lord» – icon on glass (model: Nicula, early 19th century)

• The scene shows «the Ascension of Christ», the moment when the Saviour rises into heaven in glory, while the apostles and the Mother of God look on in wonder and faith.

• “The Ascension of Christ in glory and His sitting at the right hand of the Father is the image of the complete deification of His humanity. Through all His acts – incarnation, death, resurrection – He gradually deified the human nature He had taken on, but through the Ascension He transfigured it completely. Thanks to the supreme transfiguration of His body, Christ can dwell within those who believe in Him. The Ascension of the Lord does not mean His withdrawal from creation, for He continues to be present and at work through the Holy Spirit. The bodily Ascension into heaven is a testimony that man was created for eternity, for the Son presents Himself to the Father not only as God, but also as Man.” (Fr. Florin Vânătoru)🙏
